text:
I have a workaround for this class of problems.  I saw this and I thought that perhaps I could turn it into its own bot to help.

https://x.ai/bot/aPie95rXmGm4w5z0H31EH

This bot will code up its own browser harness and then make it available to your other bots.  It advertises itself as regular Chrome.  It allows your bots to navigate via the direct click, a synthetic human-like mouse emulation, or direct code injection, so your bots have multiple tools to deal with picky sites.

Initially it will not have much in the way of cookies or accounts so google etc might flag it for captcha.  You can get past these the usual way, but as the browser sees more use, the captchas will subside to normal human levels.

A side effect of this is you'll have the full code to the browser MCP, so if you discover other workarounds or fixes, you can make requests of the bot to add them.
